purpose: Pinned source boundary for the hand-transcribed Python LUT and LUTEffect contract mirrors.
reviewed_contract: Builtin LUTs are generated on a 17^3 grid.
ColorLUT::setValue clamps each stored RGB grid value to [0,1].
ColorLUT lookup uses trilinear interpolation and clamps finite-sanitized RGB input and output to [0,1].
LUTEffect CPU intensity 0 leaves RGB unchanged, intensity in (0.0001,0.9999) linearly blends original and mapped RGB, and intensity >=0.9999 writes mapped RGB.
LUTEffect CPU implementation copies the input RGBA image and writes only RGB components.
refresh_rule: If either pinned source hash changes, inspect the changed source contract, update the mirrors and evidence, then update this file. Do not only replace hashes to bypass the guard.
